text:
Type: tufted diamond throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, coastal, bohemian
Materials: cotton with running-stitch embroidery, tufted dots and lattice
Colors: cream, navy, soft blue
Shape: square, diamond lattice of tufted lines with round tufted dots at the crossings, stitched concentric pattern, knife edges
Feel: soft, relaxed, crafted
Goes with: white or navy sofas, light wood, blue accents; coastal or transitional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Transitional Tufted Dot Diamond Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17" , Navy
product.description: Raised, tufted dots accent a printed geometric pattern for a three-dimensional look and texture. For an instant style change, flip it over to show off the navy linen-look back. This pillow provides a quick, eye-catching update to any style room. 17" x 17" Front: 100% cotton with polyester embroidered thread; back: 100% polyester Removable polyester fiber-filled insert included Insert can be easily removed via the bottom zipper Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry.
